text: Data/ROM/I/O pointers shall be 16 bytes aligned to `min(C,4)`; function references eight bytes with that alignment. Pointer fields shall be target-endian u32 allocation identity, allocation-relative byte offset, cached normalized coordinate, and effective read/write rights at offsets 0,4,8,12. Rights shall use bits 0/1 with other bits zero.
